rules: FINDING and PROBLEM_REPORT messages are informational and non-preemptive.
HELP_REQUEST does not suspend the requester; requester continues its original prompt unless blocked.
Helpers perform bounded support and then return to their prior lane.
Agents should offer help when appropriate, but must not abandon their original assignment unless explicitly rescheduled.
Only explicit PAUSE, RESCOPE, HANDOFF, TERMINATE/RELEASE, or a hard blocker changes the default continue-working behavior.
Manager/Primary selects the minimum useful helper count and prevents duplicate or global preemption.
Ownership transfer is explicit; reporting a problem never transfers ownership implicitly.
